errors.name: fleetCrewPageConflict

errors.name: factionDrainBlocked
errors.message: Faction drain blocked: own-faction opposition requires an outlaw declaration
errors.docs: A mission's settled action would DRAIN the rightful incumbent of a sector the actor's OWN faction holds, and the actor is not a declared outlaw — the own-faction anti-grief gate (doc 180 §3 Phase-2 faction-stance). Declare outlaw to act against your own faction.

errors.name: commitmentWindowActive
errors.docs: ClearOutlaw was attempted while the 2-epoch commitment window is still active — the outlaw flag is locked until `now >= pvp_until` (doc 180 §3d, the PvP-flag commitment).

errors.name: invalidFleetDirective
errors.docs: P5b: a directive payload is malformed — unknown `FleetDirectiveKind`, or a timestamp that does not fit the i32 epoch-relative encoding (`directive_ts_out_of_range`).

errors.name: factionDirectiveRateLimited
errors.docs: P5b: `SetFleetDirective` was called again before `last_update + DIRECTIVE_COOLDOWN_SECS` elapsed.

errors.name: fleetNotOwnedByFaction
errors.docs: P5b: the supplied fleet's `FactionOwnership(FLEET)` sidecar does not name this faction as controller, or the operator profile does not match `FactionAccount.operator_profile`.

errors.name: factionFleetCapExceeded
errors.docs: P5b: `MintNpcFleet` would exceed `FactionAccount.max_npc_fleets` (the primary anti-flood headcount cap).

errors.name: factionCaptureRateLimited
errors.docs: P5b: an NPC faction tried to capture again before its per-faction `last_capture_at + faction_capture_cooldown_secs` elapsed (the on-chain anti-blitz brake).
